name: Untappd
tagline: Social beer check-in API for breweries, bars, and craft-beer discovery apps
description: Untappd provides a REST API for beer search, brewery and venue data, user check-ins, and related social beer-tracking features. Developers authenticate with OAuth 2.0 (client credentials / user auth) and call versioned endpoints under the public API host. Official documentation, pricing, and rate-limit details should be verified on Untappd’s developer site before production use.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0: register an app for client_id/client_secret; user flows use access tokens; some endpoints accept client_id as query param for read-only public data.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No public free self-serve tier; API access requires app registration and approval/commercial terms (new keys restricted)

rate_limits: 100 calls per hour per key; with user auth, limit applies per user. Headers: X-Ratelimit-Limit, X-Ratelimit-Remaining
use_cases: search beers by name or style
get brewery details and beer list
look up a venue's beer menu or check-ins
get beer ratings and stats by beer ID
